spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact changed surface (setMicrophoneActive/setCameraActive) and inspects the return — String(ret), instanceof Promise, awaited settlement against the spec's resolve-with-undefined requirement — rather than typeof, which predates the feature.

interactive.rationale: A real button drives both live API calls and rebuilds the observed-returns table and verdict from the actual values each run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises a probe of what each build hands back including the awaited resolution value; the page does exactly that per-method.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-mediaSession browsers, missing setters, a mixed one-setter-updated build, a promise resolving with a non-undefined value, and rejected promises, each with its own labelled row/verdict.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 and the setMicrophoneActive spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts the same contract this page probes (returns-Promise per setter plus resolve-with-undefined), and its typeof assertions pin the pre-existing surface; on Chromium 153 the promise assertions fail honestly (3 pass / 4 fail observed).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): both calls returned undefined, verdict rendered the labelled pre-158 branch, repeat run stable, zero console errors/page errors/failed requests, 0px overflow at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3, both screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts shape consistency across the two setters, that every observed shape is inside the 93-or-158 contract, and the unsupported fallback as its own branch.

design_system.rationale: Design-token colours only; verdict/table state colours (emerald-dark, charcoal, rose) all sit on paper/stone backgrounds at AA; the table wraps in an overflow-x container.

accessibility.rationale: Native button with a descriptive name, table with caption and column headers, verdict and output are aria-live=polite, all state is text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; the results table scrolls inside its wrapper; 44px-min button verified in the mobile screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the 158+ branch on a real Chrome 158 build
openQuestions.detail: This environment ships Chromium 153, so the verified path is the legacy undefined return (correctly labelled). Once a Chrome 158 build is available, re-run the probe and confirm both setters return a Promise that resolves with undefined, and that the page's new-shape verdict and the suite's promise assertions flip to pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep real table semantics (caption, th scope) and let the table scroll inside a dedicated wrapper on narrow viewports instead of reflowing cells.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The observed-returns table keeps caption/th scope=col and sits in an overflow-x:auto .table-wrap; verified 0px page overflow at 360px with the table scrolling internally.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async results through a single polite live region per surface rather than rebuilding focusable content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict line and the summary output are the two polite regions; table rows are inert result data, and focus stays on the triggering button.

summary: Return-shape probe for the Chrome 158 Promise<undefined> alignment: real calls to both setters, per-method rows of String(ret)/instanceof/settlement, and a verdict that treats the pre-158 undefined as the honest legacy answer. Verified with the headless Chromium 153 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): legacy branch rendered, repeat-run stable, identical behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (no flag exists for this change), clean console/network, ok/ok responsive matrix, conformance route 3 pass / 4 fail as expected on 153.
